xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5282: Upgrade CLIProxy to v8.0.71 with a v8-layout generated config

plan.title: Upgrade CLIProxy to v8.0.71 with a v8-layout generated config
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Overdeck pins CLIProxy v7.3.16 and writes a legacy flat config.yaml by text concatenation with config.extra.yaml appended verbatim. Upstream is v8.0.71 with a nested v8 layout. PAN-5278 needs session affinity, a localhost management API with a known key, and Claude and Codex accounts that do not collide on Codex-aliased model names. Today a running proxy is never upgraded (startCliproxy returns early), and writing a v8 config under a hot-reloading v7 would break it.
narratives.Proposal: Bump the pin to v8.0.71. Build the config as an object in a new pure module src/lib/cliproxy-config.ts (base layout, legacy-key conversion of extra, deep merge, client-token preservation, management key precedence, Codex-alias exclusion from the Claude channel, semantic write compare, start planner). Put async path-taking file helpers in src/lib/cliproxy-config-files.ts (management key file, extra reader, writeCliproxyConfig with 0600 modes). Wire them into cliproxy.ts so the v8 layout is written only once the installed binary is the pin; startCliproxy downloads before stopping a stale running proxy. Delete the sync and text-based twins. Verify against a throwaway v8.0.71 on port 18317, then update docs/CONFIGURATION.md, configuration/harnesses.mdx, the cliproxy skill and the changelog.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Converting legacy gemini-api-key or codex: blocks in config.extra.yaml
- Rewriting per-account excluded_models in auth JSON files
- Collecting aliases from per-auth model_aliases in auth JSON files
- Changing or validating the operator's alias targets in config.extra.yaml
- Editing the operator's config.extra.yaml on disk
- Restarting CLIProxy on dashboard boot or pan reload
- Reset-first routing, the pooled usage panel, or any management-API client code (PAN-5278)
- Signing a Claude account in (operator step after merge)
- Touching port 8317, ~/.overdeck/cliproxy/ or the live proxy from tests or the probe

autoDecisions.summary: The upgrade of a running stale proxy happens only on explicit start paths (pan up, pan dev, pan restart --cliproxy, the Restart CLIProxy button, the watchdog), not on dashboard reload.
autoDecisions.rationale: A reload-time restart would interrupt in-flight GPT requests on every routine deploy; the upgrade is one-time and the operator triggers it right before signing Claude in. Docs and changelog tell them to run pan restart --cliproxy.

autoDecisions.summary: When a stale proxy is running, startCliproxy downloads the new binary before stopping the old one, and writes the v8 config only after the install.
autoDecisions.rationale: A failed download then leaves the old proxy running on its untouched legacy config instead of leaving the operator with no proxy.

autoDecisions.summary: Avoid config churn with a semantic compare that ignores CLIProxy's bcrypt rewrite of management.secret-key, not a sidecar file or an in-memory cache.
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified that CLIProxy (v7 live and v8 probe) rewrites only secret-key on startup; the compare works across the CLI and dashboard processes and still restores a hand-edited config.yaml.

autoDecisions.summary: Use global oauth.excluded-models.claude only; drop the first draft's per-account fallback.
autoDecisions.rationale: A planning-time probe of v8.0.71 showed the global list hides all aliased names from a Claude auth file; the work item 9 probe re-checks it and escalates instead of improvising.

autoDecisions.summary: A bcrypt-shaped secret-key in config.extra.yaml is ignored with a log line and the management-key file's plaintext key is used.
autoDecisions.rationale: The key file must always hold the active plaintext key for PAN-5278; a hash cannot be used as a bearer key.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the pure builder in src/lib/cliproxy-config.ts and the file I/O in src/lib/cliproxy-config-files.ts unconditionally.
autoDecisions.rationale: Pure functions get direct unit tests, the file helpers take paths so tests use their own temp dirs, and cliproxy.ts stays a lifecycle module without a circular import.

autoDecisions.summary: Leave CLIProxy's management control panel at its default (enabled) rather than setting management.disable-control-panel in the base config.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator uses the Management Center panel today (~/.overdeck/cliproxy/static exists); operators who want it off set it in config.extra.yaml.

autoDecisions.summary: Write config.yaml in place with writeFile, never temp file plus rename.
autoDecisions.rationale: The v8 probe showed an in-place write is hot-reloaded within about a second while a rename-based edit was missed by the watcher.

autoDecisions.summary: Also write config.yaml with mode 0600 and tighten an existing file.
autoDecisions.rationale: The file holds the Gemini key and, until CLIProxy hashes it, the plaintext management key; the live file is 0664 today.
